notes: Mirror met quality/payload gates against learned LEO and outperformed rank-3 additive control in both aligned seeds, but failed end-to-end runtime gate.
Native Givens conditioner exactly matched Mirror task codes, payload hashes and output RMSE in both seeds.
Independent least-squares fit reached <0.08 query RMSE in both seeds; it used 1282 bytes versus 1206 Mirror bytes.
